about: Curated adjustments to the dictionary links that tools/r12_glossary.py computes. See LINKING.md. `collocates` are words or short phrases that mark the legal sense of an everyday word: one of them within about 24 words of the term settles the sense test (a phrase counts only when all its words are in that window). `legalOnly` lists Wex slugs that need no sense test; `never` lists Wex slugs that are never linked; `neverInCourse` lists, per slug, the courses whose entries use the word in another sense (agency, principal and removal in LRS mean administrative agency, principal officer and removal of officers, not the agency-law and removal-to-federal-court articles); `add` and `remove` are per-entry corrections (entry id -> Wex slugs). `blockedNextWords` lists, per slug, words that turn the term into the atlas's own idiom ("assigned pages", "Assignment 05") and stop the match.
